description: This file defines the CauchyDistribution class, which implements the Cauchy distribution, including methods for probability density, cumulative probability, inverse cumulative probability, and accessors for distribution parameters. It extends from AbstractRealDistribution and utilizes external classes and exceptions related to random number generation and mathematical functions.

classes.name: CauchyDistribution
classes.description: Implements the Cauchy distribution with adjustable median and scale, providing methods for density, cumulative probability, inverse cumulative probability, and distribution parameters.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative probability for a given value x based on the arctangent function.

methods.name: getMedian
methods.description: Returns the median parameter of the distribution.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Returns the scale parameter of the distribution.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Computes the probability density function value at a given point x.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the inverse of the cumulative distribution function at probability p, handling edge cases at 0 and 1.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns Double.NaN as the mean of the distribution is undefined.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns Double.NaN as the variance of the distribution is undefined.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY, the lower support bound.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY, the upper support bound.

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Returns false indicating the support lower bound is not inclusive.

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Returns false indicating the support upper bound is not inclusive.

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the support of the distribution is connected.
